# CheapBuddy

> OpenAI-compatible multi-model API gateway with one balance and one API key. Base URL: https://api.cheapbuddy.cc/v1. Supports WorkBuddy, Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, and other compatible clients.

Send the public model `id` (for example `deepseek-flash` or `claude-opus-5-5`), not the display name. OpenAI-compatible clients must keep `/v1` on `base_url` (`https://api.cheapbuddy.cc/v1`); the client appends `/chat/completions` or `/responses`. Claude models accept Anthropic Messages (`POST /v1/messages`) or that OpenAI-compatible surface. Prices on model cards are a vendor reference rate or the CheapBuddy customer rate, depending on the card. Read the live card for current rates. This file is not a price list.

CheapBuddy is an independent gateway. It is not operated by DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI, or other model vendors.

The Models list is generated from the site catalog and includes all 32 public ids. A key can call only the models its group authorizes. Check `GET https://api.cheapbuddy.cc/v1/models`.

## Docs

- [API docs](https://cheapbuddy.cc/api-docs): Text, image, and video request shapes. Production base URL is https://api.cheapbuddy.cc/v1.
- [Homepage](https://cheapbuddy.cc/): Account, model shelf, and the config generator for WorkBuddy, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex.
- [Model shelf](https://cheapbuddy.cc/#models): Live model cards. A card shows either a vendor reference rate or the CheapBuddy customer rate; use the card for current numbers.
- [Blog](https://cheapbuddy.cc/blog): Client setup notes that point at the same base URL and model ids.
- [DeepSeek Harness](https://cheapbuddy.cc/blog/deepseek-harness-cheapbuddy): Add an OpenAI-compatible provider in DeepSeek Harness Settings, with /v1 on the base URL. CheapBuddy is not DeepSeek Harness.
- [CLI base URLs](https://cheapbuddy.cc/blog/cli-base-url-templates): Where Chat Completions, Responses, and Anthropic Messages base URLs should stop.
- [Claude access](https://cheapbuddy.cc/blog/claude-stable-channel-guide): Authorized Claude ids over Anthropic Messages or the OpenAI-compatible API.
- [One balance](https://cheapbuddy.cc/blog/one-balance-model-routing): Why one key and one USD balance can reach many authorized models.
- [Media API](https://cheapbuddy.cc/blog/cheapbuddy-media-api-guide): Image generation and asynchronous video download.
- [GPT Image 2.6 guide](https://cheapbuddy.cc/blog/gpt-image-2-6-guide): Prompt structure and OpenAI-compatible image generation API examples for GPT Image 2.6.
- [ComfyUI workflows](https://cheapbuddy.cc/blog/comfyui-cheapbuddy-workflows): Text, image, and video nodes inside a ComfyUI workflow.

## Models

Text:

Image:

- [gpt-image-2.5](https://cheapbuddy.cc/api-docs): id `gpt-image-2.5`; OpenAI; Image generation and editing through the image API. POST /v1/images/generations.
- [gpt-image-2.6](https://cheapbuddy.cc/en/model/gpt-image-2-6/): id `gpt-image-2.6`; OpenAI; Image generation and editing through the image API. POST /v1/images/generations.

Video:

- [MiniMax-H3](https://cheapbuddy.cc/api-docs): id `MiniMax-H3`; MiniMax; Async text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video generation. POST /v1/videos.

## Optional

- [ComfyUI nodes](https://cheapbuddy.cc/comfyui): Install page for the text, image, and video nodes.
- [Hypit provider](https://cheapbuddy.cc/hypit): Install @cheapbuddy/provider and generate MiniMax-H3 video in Hypit.
- [Examples](https://github.com/GiantClam/cheapbuddy-examples): Sample clients for the public API.
